title: Passive voice and processes
function: Describe processes and actions without mentioning the agent

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn the passive voice to describe processes and actions when the doer is unknown or unimportant.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. The window is cleaned every day. The book was written in 1990. English is spoken all over the world. Notice: be + past participle.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Describe the process of making coffee using the passive voice.
